title: Governed coordinate fallback
objective: Activate a lower-ceiling coordinate fallback only after structured UIA actuation is live. Every proposal must bind one exact capture generation and target window; every execution must bind one exact action/coordinate, one fresh single-use input lease, one approval, and one execution with human physical input interruption and deterministic stale/replay failure.

include: coordinate proposals derived from one exact current window capture generation with logical/physical/DPI normalization

server-issued single-use InputLease bound to process/window/capture generation, action kind, exact coordinate or bounded scroll/text payload digest, workspace/policy/trust revision, issue/expiry time, and approval identity
initial actions limited to click, double-click, right-click, bounded scroll, and bounded Unicode text input
native input implementation that does not use the clipboard for text injection and that preserves/restores no hidden user state
human physical input detection that immediately cancels/revokes active coordinate execution authority
pre-execution revalidation of process/window identity, capture generation, geometry/DPI, session, protected-surface status, approval, lease freshness, and policy/trust revision
single execution followed by bounded post-observation; input lease is consumed regardless of success once dispatch begins

tests for moved/resized windows, DPI changes, stale captures, coordinate overflow, human interruption, replay/double-click confusion, lease expiry, process/HWND reuse, lock/logoff/RDP transition, and protected/security surfaces
exclude: silent fallback from structured actuation failure
remote coordinate fallback until SG-000084 explicitly permits a bounded scope

authority_delta.ui_input: One bounded native pointer/scroll/text action may execute against one exact locally authorized window under a single-use lease and approval. No generic input stream is added.
authority_delta.secrets: Password/credential/security targets remain denied; typed text evidence stores only bounded metadata/digest per the approved contract.
authority_delta.approval: Each coordinate execution requires fresh exact-binding approval plus a single-use InputLease; neither can be minted/reused by the model.

invariants: coordinate input is explicit fallback, never automatic widening
one lease authorizes at most one exact action on one exact current window/capture
human physical input always wins and revokes active synthetic input authority
clipboard, unrestricted hotkeys/drag, screen-wide input, and protected surfaces remain denied

acceptance.claim: Each supported coordinate action executes at most once on the exact target/capture/geometry bound into one fresh lease and approval.
Stale capture/window/process/session/DPI/geometry, lease replay/expiry, approval drift, and protected/security targets fail closed before input dispatch.
Human physical input interrupts/revokes active synthetic authority deterministically and no automatic retry occurs.
No clipboard typing, unrestricted hotkeys, arbitrary drag/free-form input, silent structured-to-coordinate fallback, whole-screen authority, secure desktop, or remote widening is introduced.
Exact-head real-Windows tests, CI, TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, security review, and zero unresolved blockers pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000083: Provider/model action adapters may target the canonical proposal contract only after every executable computer-use path has exact Quntal authority semantics.

done_when: Bounded coordinate fallback is canonically qualified as a single-use, exact-target, human-interruptible lower-ceiling authority with no raw-input widening.
